reviewItem.question: Does "073ccf7c35a63bb203b8c78dec3e8a7c2efecdeb: fix(#19314, #15700): allow `ssh`/`altssh` subdomains in repo URLs to match webhook payload" mean a change to protocol-behavior:argo-cd|name=webhook-repo-url-matching (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 changes webhook matching so that repo URLs containing ssh or altssh subdomains are now allowed to match the webhook payload, where previously such URLs did not match.
